def ppos(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:

    return None
def redpx(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R': return n['pixels']
    return 0
